q: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’

s: the sea says wisdom (denies that it is with the sea)
q: The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

s: Destruction and Death has heard wisdom (only a rumor)
q: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

s: bird of prey does not know mining (the path of the mine)
q: That path no bird of prey knows

s: lion has not passed mining (the fierce lion has not passed by the path)
q: nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

s: wisdom cannot be bought with silver (its price is not weighed in silver)
q: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

s: wisdom has value above rubies (price of wisdom)
q: Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

s: wisdom is hidden from bird of prey (kept close from the birds of the sky)
q: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

s: wisdom is hidden from man (hidden from the eyes of all living)
q: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living

s: wisdom is fear of the Lord (as God told man)
q: the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom.

s: God understands wisdom (knows its way and place)
q: God understands its way, and he knows its place.

s: God sees earth (looks to the ends of the earth and under the whole sky)
q: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

s: Job has relationship with God (former friendship in his prime)
q: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

s: Job has relationship with children (Job's children) (formerly around him)
q: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

s: young men has attitude toward Job (hid themselves on seeing him)
q: The young men saw me and hid themselves.

s: aged (the elderly) has attitude toward Job (rose and stood before him)
q: The aged rose up and stood.

s: princes has attitude toward Job (refrained from talking in his presence)
q: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

s: nobles has attitude toward Job (voice hushed in his presence)
q: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

s: Job's former prosperity and honor includes seat in the city gate (Job prepared his seat in the street)
q: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

s: Job's former prosperity and honor includes abundance (steps washed with butter, rock pouring oil)
q: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

s: Job's former prosperity and honor includes God's protection (God watched over him with his lamp)
q: as in the days when God watched over me;

s: Job has attribute clothed in righteousness and justice (likened to a robe and diadem)
q: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

s: Job delivers poor and needy (those Job helped) (rescued the poor who cried and the fatherless)
q: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

s: Job is a eyes to the blind and feet to the lame (role toward the disabled)
q: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

s: Job is a father to the needy (role toward the needy)
q: I was a father to the needy.

s: Job opposes unrighteous (broke their jaws and plucked prey from their teeth)
q: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

s: Job holds position chief (chose their way and sat as chief; lived as a king in the army)
q: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

s: Job has relationship with men (Job's listeners) (they listened and waited for his counsel)
q: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

s: men (Job's listeners) has attitude toward Job (waited for him as for the rain)
q: They waited for me as for the rain.

s: Job is a servant of the LORD
q: Have you considered my servant Job?

s: Job has friend Zophar the Naamathite
q: Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite

s: Job is in the hand of Satan (permitted by the LORD, life spared)
q: Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.

s: Satan comes to present himself before the LORD (on the day God's sons present themselves)
q: Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

s: Satan travels earth (going back and forth)
q: From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

s: Satan incites against job the LORD (to ruin Job without cause, per the LORD)
q: although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause

s: Eliphaz the Temanite is a friend of Job
q: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite
